annotations.title: Draft a schema from a description

description: Use when the user describes what they want to find out in documents and needs a schema for it. GeoThought's model drafts one; nothing is saved. kind: mindmap (questions grouped as a tree), relation (relations between things) or thoughtgraph (a decision graph). With reuse_my_questions, the user's saved questions are reused where they fit. Returns the draft; review it with the user, then geothought_save_schema. A schema is {kind: mindmap|relation|thoughtgraph, name, description?, questions: [Question], tree?, edges?}. A Question is {id (short, unique in the schema), text, answer_type: boolean|enum|numeric|date|text|place|list|relation, label?, enum_values? (enum), unit? (numeric), relation? {subject_type, predicate, object_type} (relation), context?, temporal?, spatial?}. A mindmap's tree is [{title, question?: <question id>, children?: [...]}]; a thought graph's edges are [{source: <question id>, target: <question id>, condition}] (the answer that leads on).
name: geothought_draft_schema
title: Draft a schema from a description
